info.title: Al-Sahel Cafe Supplies API
info.description: REST API documentation split by platform: Admin Dashboard, Cafe Mobile App, and Public Storefront.

post.summary: Log in and receive an access token
post.description: Cafe users must login with phone_number and password. The response is a bare bearer token with no permissions. Admin and delegate users may use email instead of phone_number and will receive permissions in the response.

post.summary: Register a new cafe user (admin only)
Register a cafe account (OTP verification required before login)
post.description: Creates an inactive cafe user and sends a 6-digit OTP. Verify it via POST /cafe/verify-otp: when cafe_auto_approve is active a bearer token is returned immediately, otherwise the account waits for admin approval and only a message is returned.
When cafe_auto_approve is active the user is activated and a bearer token is returned immediately. Otherwise the account stays inactive until an admin approves it, and only a message is returned.

user_id.description: Required for admin requests; customers always create addresses for themselves.

image.description: Stored as the product's primary image

ProductVariantRequest.description: A sellable size of a product. Stock lives in inventories; expiry dates on purchase order items.

InventoryRequest.description: POST adds quantity to stock; PUT sets the counted on-hand quantity. Both write a stock movement.

AuthLoginRequest.description: Cafe users must login with phone_number and password only. Email is allowed for admin and delegate users only.

email.description: Use for admin/delegate login only. Cafe users must NOT use email.

AuthResponse.description: For cafe users the response contains only the bearer token. Admin and delegate responses also include permissions.

token.description: Bearer token to use in the Authorization header

permissions.description: Included for admin/delegate users only. Omitted for cafe users.

OrderItemRequest.description: Unit price is always taken from the variant on the server.

OrderRequest.description: Totals, delivery fee and the delivery address snapshot are computed on the server.

user_id.description: The customer the order is for

PurchaseOrderRequest.description: Created as draft. POST /purchase-orders/{id}/receive adds the items to stock.
